_meta.source: Commonly cited area-based minimum character-height table applied under Legal Metrology labelling practice (derived from the erstwhile Standards of Weights & Measures (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 1977, Rule 8, carried forward in departmental practice).
_meta.disclaimer: IMPORTANT: Verify these thresholds against the current Gazette-notified text of Rule 6 / the Second Schedule before relying on this table for any enforcement action. This table is intentionally kept as editable configuration (not hard-coded logic) so a Legal Metrology officer can correct it without a code change.

declaration_min_height_mm.notes: Applied as a general legibility floor for all other mandatory declarations when panel-area-specific rules do not apply. Officers can override per-declaration minimums in Settings.

readability_checks.notes: Contrast ratio and rotation are software-readability proxies (not literal statutory text) to flag labels an average consumer would struggle to read.
